name: dev-null
author: Christian Palladini
description: dev-null.sh in the Omarchy shell: an unread badge in the bar, a glance popup, and a full keyboard-driven client drawn as a git log --graph.

barWidget.description: The dev-null.sh badge and popup. Open summons the full client: logs, threads, notifications, starred commits and profiles.

schema.label: Unread check while the panel is closed (seconds)
schema.description: Only the unread count is fetched on this timer, never the notification list: listing them marks them read on dev-null.sh and in the official app. The API allows 120 calls a minute, so this is slow by choice, not by need.

schema.label: Feed refresh while the panel is open (seconds)
schema.description: How often the feed reloads while you are looking at it.

schema.label: Lines of a commit shown in the list
schema.description: Longer commits are cut with an ellipsis. Click one to read it on the site.
